name: full
sha256_rule: sha256 over sorted (relative path, sha256 of file bytes) of every file in the task dir, __pycache__ and .pyc left out (experiments/bench/common.py:task_hash)

contextbench: Lite set (contextbench_verified, 500 items) first; the rest of the full set only if Lite runs out
gold check: every gold span matches its file at base_commit (contextbench.gold_check)
the gold patch applies at base_commit (git apply --check over the gold and patched files)
the largest gold file is over 20,000 characters (utf-8, bad bytes replaced)

draw: the prior items in the pool first; then random.Random(seed).sample over the rest of the pool sorted by item id, the whole of it; walk that order, skip an item whose repo already has 2 in, replace an item with no needed place to plant by the next, stop at 25
legalbenchrag: full set: every query in benchmarks/<source>.json; the workdir is every document of the query's source
a document over 50,000 characters (read as the official code reads it)
a query counts for a document when all its gold spans are in that document and check (span text equals the answer)
one query per document: a prior item for its document; for every other document, random.Random(seed).choice over its queries sorted by index, documents in sorted (source, path) order

draw: the prior items in the pool first; then, with the same generator, sample over the other documents' items in that order, the whole of it; walk that order, replace an item with no needed place to plant by the next, stop at 25
docfinqa: a question is usable: its gold parses under DFQ-1 and its gold program's value matches the gold under DFQ-1 strict (docfinqa_chain.usable)
a program number is found in the filing (docfinqa.anchor)
the filing is at most 500,000 characters after the whitespace rule
one question per filing: a prior row for its filing; for every other filing, random.Random(seed).choice over its questions sorted by row, filings in sorted id order

draw: the prior rows in the pool first; then, with the same generator, sample over the other filings' items in that order, the whole of it; walk that order, replace an item with no needed place to plant by the next, stop at 25

selection.prior_rule: the earlier run's clean items (build.py CB_CLEAN, LB_CLEAN, DFQ_CLEAN) that pass their test bed's pool rule come first, in that order, so their earlier runs can be reused; a prior item takes the place of its document or filing, and the seeded draw fills the rest of the 25 from the pool without them

walk.outcome: replaced: no needed place to plant (planting broke the gold: ['tracing-attributes/src/lib.rs:668-681: its cat -n prefix starts at 653'])
